
   chainlock

  Open  Wait out a lock and decrypt its file

  ┃ Lock
  ┃ A .lock file (with its .payload next to it), or a .chainlock.tar.
  ┃ >

    Save as
    Optional. Where to write the decrypted file.
    > same name, without the extension

    Key file
    Optional. Saves the key, so you can open it again later with no wait.
    >
